words.definition: The special feeling or mood a place gives you
words.sentence: The glowing lanterns and soft jungle sounds gave the rainforest camp a calm, magical ____ at night.
wrongDefinitions: A loud siren used to call for help
A long walk through the countryside
A map showing mountains and rivers

words.definition: Used so often that it feels boring and not fresh
words.sentence: The explorer's speech was full of ____ sayings like 'the early bird gets the worm,' so everyone yawned.
wrongDefinitions: Very small and easy to carry
Ready to fight at any moment
Shiny and bright like new metal

words.definition: Producing a lot of something, like work, fruit or babies
words.sentence: Rabbits are so ____ that one pair can fill a whole meadow with babies in a single year.
wrongDefinitions: Very careful about every small detail
Afraid of going outside

wrongDefinitions: A small boat used for fishing in rivers

words.definition: A person who is walking instead of riding in something

wrongDefinitions: A person who drives a big truck
A person who studies plants
A person who rides a horse

wrongDefinitions: Too tired to finish what you started

words.sentence: Plastic trash has a ____ effect on sea birds, which can get sick if they swallow it.
wrongDefinitions: Very tasty and good to eat

words.definition: Special respect or honor shown to someone

wrongDefinitions: A small house built in the woods

A long nap after a big meal

words.definition: A sudden, total failure or embarrassing mess

wrongDefinitions: A friendly talk between two people
A small tool for fixing bikes

wrongDefinitions: A list of things for sale in a store

wrongDefinitions: Learning to read music on the piano
